vendors.name: SumUp Kvik Order
vendors.reason: SumUp Denmark's restaurant online-ordering page ('Onlinebestilling, nu med indbygget SumUp-onlinebetaling', 'Udviklet til travle restauranter'; '1.25%' transaction fee, 'Ingen faste omkostninger. Ingen binding.') - but no pickup, pre-order or chosen-time wording on the page, so the order-ahead rule is not met.
